overview: Jewelers Promenade is home to Katta’s gemcutters and lapidaries, producing ceremonial regalia, arcane‑infused jewelry, and civic ornaments.
history: Founded to centralize gemcutting and precious‑metal craft.
Arcane lapidaries introduced resonance‑cutting for magical gemstones.
Guild oversight ensured quality and ceremonial standards.
The district expanded to support Glassblower’s Court and Artisan Row.
hooks: A Senate coronet order is behind schedule.
A rare gemstone shipment goes missing.
Arcane gemcutting tools malfunction across the district.
A jewel thief is suspected to be hiding among the studios.
